dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I have encountered some ores nearby. I believe that they're called Magical Crystal Ores?

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: I've heard that these Crystal Ores were formed under the influence of Ley Line energies. They are very hard to come by, and very few smiths know how to work them.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: You can go have a look if you're interested, I think their locations were...

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: There, I've marked them out on your map. I mean, note-taking is a skill that every adventurer must have, no?
